# CCCSolutions - Canadian Computing Competition Solution Repository

> The most comprehensive Canadian Computing Competition (CCC) solution repository with 270+ solutions from 1996-2025

## Quick Links
- Home: https://cccsolutions.ca
- All Solutions: https://cccsolutions.ca/solutions
- Forum: https://cccsolutions.ca/forum
- GitHub: https://github.com/CCCSolutions/CCCSolutions

## What We Offer
CCCSolutions is the definitive resource for Canadian Computing Competition preparation, featuring:
- 270+ detailed solutions in C++, Python, and Java
- Complete coverage of CCC contests from 1996 to 2025
- Test cases and input/output files for verification
- Multiple solution approaches for each problem
- Difficulty ratings: Easy, Normal, Hard, Insane, Wicked
- Algorithm classification: graph theory, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, data structures, and more

## How to Find Solutions
1. Browse all solutions at https://cccsolutions.ca/solutions
2. Search by year (e.g., "2025"), problem code (e.g., "s4", "j2"), or difficulty
3. Each problem page includes multiple implementations, test cases, and algorithm tags
4. Forum available for discussion at https://cccsolutions.ca/forum

## Algorithm Topics Covered
### Graph Theory
BFS, DFS, Dijkstra's algorithm, minimum spanning tree, topological sort, shortest path algorithms

### Dynamic Programming
Interval DP, tree DP, optimization, recursion with memoization

### Data Structures
Segment trees, disjoint sets (union-find), heaps, binary search trees, stacks, queues

### Other Topics
Greedy algorithms, ad hoc problem solving, string processing, computational geometry, number theory, combinatorics

## About the CCC
The Canadian Computing Competition (CCC) is an annual programming contest organized by the Centre for Education in Mathematics and Computing (CEMC) at the University of Waterloo. It's open to students across Canada and internationally, with Junior and Senior divisions.

## Contributing
This is a community-driven project. Contributors include students from across Canada who have solved and shared their approaches to CCC problems. Visit our GitHub repository to contribute: https://github.com/CCCSolutions/CCCSolutions

## Contact & Community
